description: This file implements message queue functionalities for the Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, cleanup, put, get, peek, purge, and object core management for message queues.

methods.name: k_msgq_init
methods.description: Initializes a message queue with provided buffer, message size, and maximum messages.

methods.name: z_impl_k_msgq_alloc_init
methods.description: Allocates memory for message queue and initializes it.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_msgq_alloc_init
methods.description: Verification function for k_msgq_alloc_init syscall.

methods.name: k_msgq_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up a message queue, freeing resources if allocated.

methods.name: z_impl_k_msgq_put
methods.description: Adds a message to the queue, waiting if full.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_msgq_put
methods.description: Verification function for k_msgq_put syscall.

methods.name: z_impl_k_msgq_get_attrs
methods.description: Retrieves attributes of the message queue.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_msgq_get_attrs
methods.description: Verification function for k_msgq_get_attrs syscall.

methods.name: z_impl_k_msgq_get
methods.description: Retrieves a message from the queue, waiting if empty.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_msgq_get
methods.description: Verification function for k_msgq_get syscall.

methods.name: z_impl_k_msgq_peek
methods.description: Peeks at the first message without removing it.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_msgq_peek
methods.description: Verification function for k_msgq_peek syscall.

methods.name: z_impl_k_msgq_peek_at
methods.description: Peeks at a message at a specific index.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_msgq_peek_at
methods.description: Verification function for k_msgq_peek_at syscall.

methods.name: z_impl_k_msgq_purge
methods.description: Purges all messages and wakes up waiting threads.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_msgq_purge
methods.description: Verification function for k_msgq_purge syscall.

methods.name: z_impl_k_msgq_num_free_get
methods.description: Returns number of free message slots.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_msgq_num_free_get
methods.description: Verification function for k_msgq_num_free_get syscall.

methods.name: z_impl_k_msgq_num_used_get
methods.description: Returns number of used message slots.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_msgq_num_used_get
methods.description: Verification function for k_msgq_num_used_get syscall.
